get.description:
Diff a schema's current elements against a reference state.

Reference resolution order:
1. base_version — compare against a stored version snapshot of this schema.
2. base_schema_id — compare against the current elements of another schema.
3. Neither provided + schema has a parent_id — compare against the parent's
   current elements (natural default for a draft created via /fork).
4. Neither provided + no parent — compare against this schema's version 1
   snapshot (i.e. show all changes since creation).

post.description:
Mint primary_id / instance_id for every row of a submission.

Idempotent on ``submission_id`` — a second call with the same value
returns the previously-minted rows without bumping the partition
counter or writing new events. See
``app.services.id_generation_service.mint_ids_for_submission``.

Raises:
    HTTPException 409: One or more rows were rejected by duplicate-
        resolution classification. ``detail`` is a
        ``MintRejectionDetail``.
    HTTPException 422: Scheme is missing required templates, or
        ``partition_metadata`` lacks keys referenced by a template.

ColumnMapping.title: ColumnMapping
ColumnMapping.description:
Schema-column names the mint engine reads on accept.

Defaults to the canonical names introduced by the rename PR
(``entity_id`` / ``source_id`` / ``rep_no``). Override per gold
dataset when the bound schema uses different vocabulary — e.g. a
clinical schema declaring ``subject_id`` / ``sample_id`` / ``visit``.

Only the columns the mint engine *reads* are mapped here; the
provenance columns it *writes* (``primary_id``, ``instance_id``)
stay canonical per D13. Template tokens like ``{rep_no}`` also keep
their literal names — they're tokens, not column references.

DedupConfig.title: DedupConfig
DedupConfig.description:
Duplicate-resolution configuration nested on the identifier scheme.

Match-key shape (``disambiguator_columns`` / ``conflict_columns``)
is carried forward from today's GP2 behaviour per D20; migration to
the spec's ``match_keys`` / ``on_duplicate`` form is a future PR.

The named columns refer to schema column names directly — the
:class:`ColumnMapping` rename only affects the canonical entity /
source / rep_no columns read by the mint engine.

MintRequest.title: MintRequest
MintRequest.description:
Request body for ``POST /api/v1/ids/mint``.

Attributes
----------
gold_dataset_id
    Opaque UUID of the gold dataset the mint is scoped to.
data_project_id
    Opaque UUID of the data project producing the submission.
submission_id
    Opaque UUID of the submission. Mint is idempotent on this — a
    second call with the same value returns the already-minted rows
    without bumping any partition counter (D33 idempotency key (a)).
scheme
    The gold dataset's identifier scheme (inlined per D35; registry
    does not persist it).
rows
    Per-row inputs, each carrying its own ``partition_key``/
    ``partition_metadata`` — a request may span multiple partitions,
    grouped and locked independently by the registry.

MintResult.title: MintResult
MintResult.description:
Response body returned by ``POST /api/v1/ids/mint``.

Attributes
----------
rows
    Output rows in original ``row_index`` order.
new_count
    Number of rows that produced fresh ``entity_ids`` entries.
existing_count
    Number of rows that resolved to previously-minted IDs (idempotent
    re-mint).
pending_count
    Number of rows classified as ``pending_disambiguator``. Always
    ``0`` when the scheme has no dedup config.

MintRowInput.title: MintRowInput
MintRowInput.description:
One row sent to ``POST /api/v1/ids/mint``.

Attributes
----------
row_index
    Zero-based position of the row in the source DataFrame. Returned
    unchanged in the response and used to merge results back into the df.
entity_id
    Entity identifier from the row (was ``clinical_id`` pre-rename).
source_id
    Submitter-provided per-measurement identifier (was ``sample_id``
    pre-rename).
partition_key
    This row's denormalised partition value per D36 (multi-valued
    metadata, e.g. multi-study, uses the row's own column value).
    Rows sharing a value are grouped/locked/counted together.
partition_metadata
    This row's metadata values keyed by the template variables
    referenced in ``scheme.primary_id``/``instance_id``. Used for
    template rendering server-side.
conflict_values
    Snapshot of the row's values for the scheme's
    ``dedup.conflict_columns``. ``None`` when the scheme has no
    conflict_columns.
disambiguator_values
    Snapshot of the row's values for the scheme's
    ``dedup.disambiguator_columns``. ``None`` when the scheme has no
    disambiguator_columns.
row_hash
    Stable fingerprint of ``conflict_values`` (SHA256 hex over
    canonicalised sorted JSON). Persisted on
    ``sample_upload_event.row_hash`` for fast-path audit; ``None``
    when ``conflict_values`` is ``None``.

MintRowOutput.title: MintRowOutput
MintRowOutput.description:
Enriched per-row record returned by mint.

Attributes
----------
row_index
    Mirrors the value from the corresponding input row.
entity_id, source_id
    Echoed from input.
rep_no
    Server-derived replicate identifier (always a string on the wire).
primary_id
    Minted entity-level identifier (one per ``entity_id`` within a
    partition).
instance_id
    Minted instance-level identifier (one per
    ``(entity_id, source_id, rep_no)`` triple). ``None`` when the
    scheme has no ``instance_id`` config.
status
    ``"new"`` when this row produced fresh ``entity_ids`` entries;
    ``"existing"`` when the row was an idempotent re-mint of a
    previously-seen triple.
state
    Classification state (when the scheme has dedup config). ``None``
    when dedup is disabled — every row passes through as
    ``confirmed_rep`` server-side, but ``state`` on the output is
    ``None`` to signal "no classification ran".
reason
    Human-readable explanation of ``state``.
